title: USGS Mineral Commodity Summaries: 2025 edition
summary: The 2025 edition extends the annual commodity, trade, and import-reliance record. Individual commodity methods and withheld data govern comparison.
key_findings: The 2025 edition extends the annual commodity, trade, and import-reliance record.
Method: Annual USGS commodity surveys, estimates, trade data, and methodological notes.
Denominator: Nonfuel mineral commodities and U.S. production covered in each annual edition.
why_it_matters: This observation adds one of three time points for the usgs mineral commodity summaries series and keeps its unit, denominator, period, geography, method, attribution, and series-break context attached.
ftfn_relevance: Adds one of twelve Phase 56A primary records for asset-level grid, water, storage, and mineral performance.
Supports a within-domain time series without creating a cross-domain score.
Makes revision, denominator, and method limits visible before a direction is described.
evidence_limits: Individual commodity methods and withheld data govern comparison.
The observation is bounded to United States with international trade context and the stated period.
The denominator is Nonfuel mineral commodities and U.S. production covered in each annual edition.
Two-point movement is not presented as a durable trend without an explicit caveat.
